keyEvents.text: Fer López (Wolverhampton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Wolverhampton Wanderers 1, Derby County 0. Adam Armstrong (Wolverhampton Wanderers) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
First Half ends, Wolverhampton Wanderers 1, Derby County 0.
Substitution, Derby County. Bobby Clark replaces Filip Bilbija.
Substitution, Derby County. Lars-Jørgen Salvesen replaces Carlton Morris.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Rodrigo Gomes replaces Rafiki Saïd.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Jordan James replaces Tommy Doyle.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Marshall Munetsi replaces Fer López.
Goal! Wolverhampton Wanderers 2, Derby County 0. Mateus Mané (Wolverhampton Wanderers) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Rodrigo Gomes with a cross.
Goal! Wolverhampton Wanderers 3, Derby County 0. Adam Armstrong (Wolverhampton Wanderers) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Bertrand Traoré replaces Mateus Mané.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Jackson Tchatchoua replaces Kieran Trippier.
Substitution, Derby County. Max Johnston replaces Shane Duffy.
Substitution, Derby County. Oscar Fraulo replaces Alex Mowatt.
Substitution, Derby County. Corey Blackett-Taylor replaces Mohammed Fuseini.
Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolverhampton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Wolverhampton Wanderers 3, Derby County 0.
